project.name: Story Corner
project.design_status: EXPERIMENTAL; geometry development and full-bay creep testing required before overhead use
project.warning: The shelf body, cassettes, corbels, joinery, facade, and test pieces are printed PETG. Metal structural screws with suitable heads or washers into verified studs/blocking are still required. No load rating is claimed.

printer.filament: black PETG; brand and product line UNCONFIRMED
printer.gcode_policy: model-only 3MF until printer, nozzle, plate, PETG, and every coupon are confirmed

closet.shelf_depth_status: selected for an all-PETG 180 mm-class build envelope; FIELD CONFIRM against bins
closet.vertical_zone_measurement_status: user reported; remeasure from a common level datum

inside_corner.visible_ornament_joint_gap_status: nominal square-wall fixture measured from the through-side full removable-facade solid to the return-corner cosmetic cantilever solid; the intentionally relieved visible base opens this to 2.0 mm, and production geometry is regenerated from measured angle, bow, datum uncertainty, and reserve
inside_corner.return_corner_service_order: with the shelf fully unloaded, remove the floating return-corner finish first; only then may the fixed through rosette use its complete 4.4 mm axial service stroke
inside_corner.production_gap_formula: minimum residual solid gap + actual full removable-facade depth (cassette depth plus 13.2 mm)*tan(abs(measured angle - 90 deg)) + measured maximum wall bow + corner datum uncertainty + manufacturing/installation reserve
inside_corner.coordinate_datum: intersection of the two finished wall planes at the inside corner
inside_corner.fit_strategy: the long-wall through cassette owns the 6 x 6 in corner; its integral bosses project 7.2 mm but its full removable facade projects 13.2 mm beyond the structural front. The return structure begins after the full 4.4 mm axial service stroke plus a 1.2 mm reserve, while one removable zero-credit return-corner cantilever reaches back 4.4 mm to preserve the locked cosmetic meeting and is removed first for service
inside_corner.movement_policy: corner finish keys float on one leg; no rigid PETG joint may force two bowed or non-square walls into one plane

closet.common_shelf_top_elevation_status: UNCONFIRMED; establish one laser datum on both walls

vertical_layout.maximum_status: provisional; more levels require confirmed short contents or a separately generated compact frame
vertical_layout.level_independence_rule: each L-shaped shelf level has its own complete 7 + 4 wall-fastened support set; no printed column, rail, arch, or key transfers shelf load vertically between levels
vertical_layout.visual_alignment_rule: align the two levels' 3/6 pier stations for one coherent two-story Palatine elevation while keeping every level independently removable
vertical_layout.service_access_direction: from the visible front or open underside with all stored items removed; no production cross-key or pin may require access from the wall side or from above an installed cassette
vertical_layout.installation_order: install and fully service-check the upper level first, then install the lower level; each level remains independently removable
vertical_layout.placement_gate: confirm loaded bin/item height, outlet and plug service envelope, ceiling bow, driver access, and crown-pin removal access before freezing either elevation

storage_contents.measurement_status: UNCONFIRMED; measure every intended bin at its widest rim, deepest lid or handle, and loaded height before confirming the 6 in shelf depth or shelf spacing

support.primary_support_material: printed black PETG tied-spandrel pier/corbel assemblies; experimental
support.wall_connection: nonprinted metal structural screws with integral washer heads or compatible metal washers into verified wood studs or purpose-installed blocking
support.regular_3_6_arcade_blocking_policy: continuous wood blocking behind the finished wall is required for nominal pier rhythm unless every generated structural station is field-verified over framing; a printed surface rail is not accepted as a substitute before its own full-scale creep qualification
support.stud_locked_fallback: regenerate structural stations and bay widths from verified framing; retain three and six visible arches but permit unequal intercolumniation and independent ornamental half-piers
support.production_wall_connection_gate: BLOCKED until the exact structural screw shank, head or washer outside diameter, length, thread embedment, maximum driver diameter, straight driver approach, stud/blocking species and thickness, and wall finish thickness are field verified and regenerated into the wall mockup

structure.cassette_mapping: one structural deck cassette per tied-arcade half-bay; each fixed crown seam uses three diaphragm keys, one positive keeper strip, and one front-inserted entablature tie, while each floating pier seam uses three elongated diaphragm keys physically trapped by its integral corbel cap; stitch rails are excluded from the installed baseline

stitch_rail_baseline_policy.reason: the cassette already has integral front/rear chords, every seam has three diaphragm keys, every bay has one fixed crown tie, and every pier boundary is directly corbel-supported; the geometry-current optional study's 41 segments, 74 pins, and 4 end ties would add 119 unqualified thermal-loop objects per level without a proven load-path benefit
stitch_rail_baseline_policy.future_reentry_gate: a guarded rail-on versus rail-off full-bay test must demonstrate a material stiffness, recovery, or failure-mode benefit without reducing the full 1.2 mm pier-seam movement before any rail object returns to an installed package

optional_research_rail_interface_contrac.attachment_ownership_rule: at every floating supported-pier seam the run-start/left rail half owns only the locator at seam - 42 mm and the run-end/right rail half owns only the locator at seam + 42 mm; neither rail, saddle, cassette, lock, ornament, nor adhesive may add an axial attachment inside the +/-38 mm crossover keepout
optional_research_rail_interface_contrac.saddle_pass_through_rule: both rails pass through open-ended saddle channels with 0.4 mm transverse fit clearance and no run-axis end wall; the rail and remaining saddle lands finish flush at e = 138 mm and share broad vertical bearing only
optional_research_rail_interface_contrac.thermal_loop_rule: the left cassette/saddle datum is tight, the right cassette saddle pocket and locks provide 1.2 mm, and the rail overlap slot provides 1.2 mm; the minimum series motion of the complete cassette-saddle-rail loop is therefore 1.2 mm
optional_research_rail_interface_contrac.load_credit_rule: rail top chords and saddle lands may receive candidate compression-bearing credit only after full-bay testing; locator ridges, overlap pins, elongated slots, and crossover contact receive zero longitudinal-tension credit

optional_research_run_end_tie_interface.rear_socket_axial_class: fixed datum within the local two-rail end pair
optional_research_run_end_tie_interface.start_end_handing_rule: run-start tie inserts along +run and run-end tie is the true mirrored part inserting along -run; an unmirrored common mesh is prohibited
optional_research_run_end_tie_interface.positive_keeper_rule: two integral accessible flexural hooks enter 1.2 mm positive rail notches only after the 12 mm hard-stop shoulders seat; hooks are anti-withdrawal retainers with zero transverse or shelf-load credit and must pass the actual-orientation creep/cycle coupon
optional_research_run_end_tie_interface.corner_rule: each tie connects only the two rail lines of one run end; no tie crosses or rigidifies the inside corner

stitch_rail_planner.status: OPTIONAL RESEARCH GEOMETRY ONLY; excluded from the installed release-candidate inventory
stitch_rail_planner.installed_coordinate_rule: x follows the wall run; q is rear-to-front shelf depth; z is below the cassette underside. Rear and front rails remain separate printed trains and terminate at every run end.

structure.rail_to_cassette_joint_role: OPTIONAL RESEARCH ONLY; zero installed baseline objects and zero capacity credit
structure.stitch_rail_movement_policy: if the optional study is revived, every rail line must preserve the full 1.2 mm cassette/saddle movement; neither rail may bypass or rigidly lock a floating pier seam
structure.structural_joint_rule: the release-candidate baseline contains no stitch rail, rail pin, rail overlap, or run-end tie; optional research geometry is not an installed interface

tied_arcade.structural_system: two-half closed tied-spandrel load-sharing frame per visible bay; the regenerated curved rib, compact spring clevises, minimum haunch webs, cassette-entablature top chord, and X-braced wall corbels form the candidate mixed-action chassis; a redundant full-height structural pier is prohibited
tied_arcade.structural_credit_status: candidate load-sharing system only; zero numerical capacity credit until crown, full-bay, wall-mockup, cyclic, comparative arch-on/arch-off, destructive, recovery, and creep tests pass
tied_arcade.support_station_rule: one independently wall-fastened structural pier/X-corbel at every nominal bay boundary; 7 stations serve the six-bay through arm and 4 stations serve the three-bay return
tied_arcade.coordinate_system: front arcade elevation: u runs along each wall/run between pier centerlines, y runs vertically from the chassis datum, and z is chassis depth normal to the facade; y = 0 is the lowest ornamental/chassis datum and y = 168 is the shelf/cassette top; the orthogonal wall-to-front side plane is defined separately under corbel
tied_arcade.arch_crown_definition: the separate 14 mm radial rib occupies y = 124..138 at crown and seats against the cassette underside at y = 138 without solid-volume overlap; it is an arch-like member in a mixed-action tied frame, not an assumed pure-compression masonry arch
tied_arcade.arch_to_cassette_interface_rule: separate printed parts meet only on the two broad top compression pads at the y = 138 cassette underside plus the broad spring shoulder, through their named open-bottom receivers; no curved-rib or entablature solid overlap is permitted
tied_arcade.visual_facade_geometry_rule: the removable zero-credit facade retains the 60 to 152 mm visual arch; structural generators must use the separate 46 to 138 mm structural arch fields

rear_crown_bridge.insertion_path: insert upward from below along +y into the rear crown keyways until the integral top shoulders meet a hard positive stop at the cassette underside e = 138; the bridge remains wholly below the cassette and no through-top slot is permitted
rear_crown_bridge.removal_path: with the shelf fully unloaded, remove the accessible retention pin and translate the bridge downward along -y; no cassette or ornament removal may be required to reach the pin

dovetail_rails.keyway_datum_rule: the bridge and installed keyways remain centered at nominal seam u = +/-28.0; each handed arch source cuts its keyway 27.825 mm inward from its physical crown face, compensating the +/-0.175 mm half-seam offset without widening the 72 mm bridge or reducing its exact 3.2 mm outer lug wall
dovetail_rails.open_bottom_keyway_rule: over the complete 10.4 mm source keyway-head interval 22.625..33.025 mm inward from each physical crown face, the exact long/return common parent rib is e = 120.646226096..131.231041356; the installed centers remain nominal-seam u = +/-28, the lug occupies e = 120.9..127.9, the open-bottom sweep ends at e = 127.9, and the remaining worst-case roof is 3.331041356 mm without inventing sidewalls in air

rear_crown_bridge.retention_pin_role: anti-drop and reverse-slide retention only; no shelf-load capacity is assigned to the pin
rear_crown_bridge.retention_pin_axis: from the visible front toward the wall along -q
rear_crown_bridge.front_shear_ear_owner: right structural arch half only; the 19.4 x 19.4 boss positively overlaps the real crown rib over u = 0..19.4 and never crosses the crown seam
rear_crown_bridge.rear_shear_ear_owner: right fixed-crown cassette only; the ear hangs from the cassette underside with a 0.02 mm positive parent union and never touches the left-owned keeper
rear_crown_bridge.rear_shear_ear_parent_transition_rule: the right cassette preserves an uncut 3.2 x 3.2 mm parent spine at q = 124.4..127.6/e = 138..141.2 immediately beyond the third diaphragm receiver boundary; a support-light <=45 degree transition flares into the hanging ear without crossing q = 124.4, and the generator must prove one connected body and top-skin-down per-layer continuity
rear_crown_bridge.positive_keeper_rule: the one-piece pin uses an integral split tail that expands behind the rear shear ear and has an open-underside release window; friction alone is not accepted

retention_pin_positive_tail_contract.construction: longitudinally split circular shaft; two circular segments of the 5.0 mm shaft remain after a centered 1.2 mm u slot, so the compressed arms fit the 5.4 mm circular parent bores without rectangular-corner interference
retention_pin_positive_tail_contract.release_method: with the shelf fully unloaded, use bounded needle-nose tips from the open underside to squeeze both exposed arms to outer radius <= 2.7 mm while pulling the visible head along +q; no parent solid or second keeper may occupy the release window
retention_pin_positive_tail_contract.saved_orientation: q shaft axis parallel to the build plate; split plane perpendicular to the plate; the round head and circular shaft cross-section stand vertical/tangent to the plate
retention_pin_positive_tail_contract.required_generator_proof: one-body chain from ramp/barbs through split shaft, 0.4 mm unsplit union and 0.4 mm head union; expanded final, circular-segment compressed proxy, every-0.4-mm insertion, squeeze/removal, bridge/ear/parent and release-window Boolean checks
retention_pin_positive_tail_contract.required_physical_gate: same-PETG actual-parent pin/ear coupon; 100 complete insertion-squeeze-removal cycles; 20 thermal cycles; 30-day screen and 90-day migration release gate

rear_crown_bridge.single_pin_rule: only the right/fixed half receives the circular retention pin; a second fixed pin is prohibited because it would overconstrain the upward sliding bridge

spring_final_x_vertical_joint.installation_motion: straight upward at final run coordinate; no whole-half longitudinal slide is permitted
spring_final_x_vertical_joint.retention_wedge_axis: front to rear along +q through the generated full-depth capital oculus, followed by a visible-front quarter-turn
spring_final_x_vertical_joint.structural_arc_regeneration_rule: regenerate the 92 mm rise structural arc from local u = 28.8/e = 46 to the physical crown face/e = 138; the root starts 0.4 mm beyond the actual u = 28.4 compact-clevis housing envelope, and the below-housing transition must create positive-volume union without entering the lift sweep
spring_final_x_vertical_joint.visual_column_role: the separate six-flute facade overlay supplies the continuous classical pier appearance and receives zero structural credit
spring_final_x_vertical_joint.receiver_projection_rule: the receiver housing may project beyond the nominal 144 mm 3:4:5 brace node; the brace node is not the shelf-front datum
spring_final_x_vertical_joint.load_path_rule: the broad shoulder, tenon side bearing, pier receiver and X-corbel are the candidate load-sharing path; the positive quarter-turn cross-key only prevents withdrawal and receives zero shelf-load capacity credit

retention_wedge.schema_alias: the stable retention_wedge config path is retained for release-inventory compatibility only; the emitted object is the positive_quarter_turn_cross_key and no straight wedge is permitted
retention_wedge.mechanism: visible-front captive-bayonet cross-key: a two-lug crossbar enters vertically through the front gate, rotates 90 degrees inside an oversized circular chamber, and is positively indexed by an exposed integral flex-latch
retention_wedge.printed_material: same qualified black PETG as the actual-parent receiver coupon
retention_wedge.installed_coordinate_system: u = receiver run direction, y = vertical, q = visible front toward wall/rear; receiver front face is q = 0
retention_wedge.through_hole_shape: circular cutter through both receiver cheeks and the captured tenon
retention_wedge.shaft_profile: eight-facet roundish shaft with a saved-orientation build flat; maximum across-flats and corner envelope are bounded by the configured diameter

front_bayonet_boss.wrong_way_rule: the only positive index notch is at the 90 degree locked orientation; the entry orientation has no latch seat and is visibly different

crossbar.rotation_direction_viewed_from_visible_f: clockwise +90 degrees to lock; counterclockwise -90 degrees to release

visible_handle_and_positive_index.flexure_path_rule: the integral flexure follows the authored folded-U centerline inside the 19.2 mm handle envelope; its exact 25.8 mm path must remain at least the conservative 20.0 mm strain length, so a fictitious straight 19.2 mm flexure is prohibited
visible_handle_and_positive_index.strain_formula: 6 * release deflection * flexure thickness / developed length^2; screening geometry only, not a material-life claim
visible_handle_and_positive_index.anti_rotation_rule: the exposed dog occupies the unique hard-sided boss notch after the quarter-turn; friction and an unindexed detent are prohibited
visible_handle_and_positive_index.release_rule: with the shelf fully unloaded, pull the exposed flex tab 1.6 mm toward the visible front, rotate the handle 90 degrees counterclockwise to the vertical entry index, then withdraw straight toward the visible front

ordered_install_stages: approach from the visible front with the crossbar vertical and latch dog clear
translate exactly 27.2 mm along +q until the crossbar is centered in the rotation chamber
rotate clockwise from 0 to 90 degrees at fixed q; the complete crossbar corner sweep stays inside the circular chamber
release the exposed flex tab so its dog enters the unique locked notch with 1.2 mm nominal axial engagement
ordered_removal_stages: fully unload the shelf and expose the visible handle
deflect the visible flex tab 1.6 mm along -q so the dog clears its notch by 0.4 mm
rotate counterclockwise from 90 to 0 degrees at fixed q
withdraw exactly 27.2 mm along -q through the vertical entry gate

saved_print_orientation.orientation: locked crossbar and handle broad faces on the plate; shaft axis parallel to the plate; configured shaft build flat down
saved_print_orientation.orientation_gate: slice and print the same-PETG key plus actual-parent boss/receiver coupon in this exact orientation; confirm continuous layers at shaft/crossbar and flexure roots before production mapping

qualification_gate.migration_orientation: actual installed receiver orientation with the key latched and the parent coupon mounted as installed
required_pass_conditions: no unlatching, 90 degree index loss, gate escape, crack, whitening, layer split, or permanent interference
latch dog positive engagement remains at least 0.8 mm after the maximum 0.4 mm installed outward float, cycling, and both migration dwells
key remains removable from the visible front using the declared 1.6 mm release motion
installed outward float never exceeds 0.4 mm and total chamber axial clearance never exceeds 0.8 mm
fit result is recorded for the exact printer, nozzle, layer height, PETG brand/color/dry state, orientation, and clearance rung
qualification_gate.failure_rule: any missed index, self-rotation, axial gate escape, rear-access requirement, flexure damage, or nonserviceable key fails the interface and blocks all complete-shelf packages

retention_wedge.insertion_axis: front to rear along +q at the vertical entry index, followed by a visible-front quarter-turn
retention_wedge.retention_role: withdrawal retention only; zero vertical, bearing, longitudinal-tension, or shelf-load capacity credit and no numerical load rating
retention_wedge.removal_rule: fully unload, release the visible positive index, quarter-turn to the entry orientation, and pull from the visible front; no wall/rear, above-cassette, or hidden-keeper access is permitted

cassette_final_x_vertical_tenon_joint.installation_motion: straight upward at final run coordinate; entry and installed u centers are identical
cassette_final_x_vertical_tenon_joint.retention_wedge_axis: front to rear along +q through the generated full-depth facade oculus, followed by a visible-front quarter-turn
cassette_final_x_vertical_tenon_joint.center_coordinate_basis: u measured from the crownward physical end face toward the pier; use the smallest internal physical cassette width in each run so outer modules inherit additional pier-side margin
cassette_final_x_vertical_tenon_joint.crown_bridge_collision_rule: the governing return receiver begins at u = 40.2 mm, leaving 4.2 mm beyond the 72 mm crown-bridge body half-envelope at u = 36 mm; its shortened 19.2 mm locked handle leaves the unchanged 4.0 mm minimum crown ligament, adjacent handles retain 3.36 mm, and all cross-key axes miss the bridge and rear return ear
cassette_final_x_vertical_tenon_joint.load_path_rule: two broad top pads plus the broad spring shoulder form three candidate bearing interfaces per half; tenons locate the half and their positive quarter-turn cross-keys only prevent withdrawal, with zero vertical capacity credit

assembly_kinematics: install and align the independently wall-fastened pier/X-corbels with integral caps and the cassette train with every cross-key receiver empty

hold one arcade half at its final run coordinate and lift it straight upward so its two cassette tenons and one spring tenon enter their open-bottom receivers together; do not translate the half along the run
seat both cassette compression pads and the broad spring shoulder against their three positive bearing stops
insert and visibly index two accessible cassette cross-keys and one accessible spring cross-key from the visible front; these retain against withdrawal only
repeat for the other half without crossing the crown seam
insert the rear crown bridge upward from below to its hard stop and install its one accessible fixed-side double-shear anti-drop pin
install removable isolated ornament only after every structural cross-key and pin is proven serviceable through its full-depth oculus or by carrier removal
tied_arcade.disassembly_kinematics: fully unload and remove ornament; squeeze and pull the fixed-right crown pin, lower the crown bridge, release/quarter-turn/withdraw all three cross-keys from each half, lower each half vertically at final u, remove the visible-front tie pins and ties, remove the underside keeper pins and strips, then service keys, locks, cassettes and corbels; no step may require a whole-half longitudinal slide
kinematic_no_go_conditions: any wall-side-only or above-cassette cross-key/pin access
any cross-key or pin assigned vertical shelf-load capacity
any receiver or access tunnel intersecting the crown bridge swept envelope
tied_arcade.structural_print_orientation: arcade halves use their broad elevation face on the plate; X-corbels use the separate wall-contact-face orientation declared under corbel; neither orientation is support-free before its exact same-PETG support/coupon gate passes

arch_print_connectivity_contract.named_support_zones: the centered-depth 16 mm compression pads/spring shoulder and all three 8 mm tenons begin above the broad build face and require an exact same-PETG support or sacrificial strategy plus an actual-orientation coupon; broad-face placement alone is not print-readiness proof

tied_arcade.mechanics_note: the near-semicircular rib is part of a closed tied-spandrel frame and is expected to carry mixed actions, not guaranteed pure arch compression; only comparative full-bay tests may establish whether it materially improves stiffness or failure behavior

compact_segmental_reference_only.status: historical unqualified low-profile study retained only for comparison; no value in this object may override the grand near-semicircular main design

corbel.style: side-printed Triadic Roman X-braced corbel with exact 3:4:5 diagonals; classical moldings are isolated nonstructural overlays
corbel.coordinate_system: x = 0 at finished wall and x increases toward the shelf front; y shares the tied-arcade elevation datum
corbel.crossing_rule: both 12 mm diagonal paths are unioned through one minimum 24 mm boss at x = 82.666667, y = 92; coincident but disconnected members are prohibited

upper_diagonal_cassette_union_segment_mm.rule: 21.383333 mm is only the diagonal centerline datum at e = 133.2; the actual 12 mm brace reaches q = 24.983333 at the cassette underside and its open-bottom cradle cutter reaches q = 25.383333 after fit clearance. Outside the compact spring housing, the descending X is clipped at wall projection 140.35 mm, exactly 0.4 mm behind the ornament-compatible moving-arch shoulder at 140.75 mm, while remaining positively unioned through the receiver transition. The continuous top skin and all named 3.2 mm ligaments remain mandatory

corbel.direct_springing_path_note: the descending diagonal links the lowered y = 46 front springing shoulder to the y = 154 upper wall node; the rising diagonal links the lower wall node to the y = 138 cassette underside. Both are exact 144 x 108 x 180 mm paths, but the rear cassette cradle and full assembly still require physical qualification and establish no rating
corbel.wall_screw_station_status: PROVISIONAL LOCATIONS ONLY; production bores, pockets, bosses, tunnels, and stations are blocked until the actual structural screw and wall build-up are measured
corbel.wall_screw_head_pocket_formula: actual integral head or metal washer outside diameter + 0.6 mm
corbel.wall_screw_boss_od_formula: max(22 mm, actual integral head or washer outside diameter + 8 mm)
corbel.driver_tunnel_x_brace_rule: every horizontal wall-fastener driver axis crosses at least one X diagonal in side elevation; a tunnel may be generated only as a center corridor through the 28 mm body while preserving two continuous side webs

integrated_bearing_cap.full_width_cap_reason: the complete 48 mm cap keeps both vertical cassette-lock axes outside the 28 mm X-body while preserving a 3.2 mm bore-to-edge ligament; exact 75 mm insertion/removal sweeps are clear at all 22 installed stations
integrated_bearing_cap.rising_x_endpoint_union_rule: the rising 3:4:5 X endpoint is unioned directly into the cap at xwall = 144/e = 138; face contact without shared solid volume is prohibited
integrated_bearing_cap.candidate_bearing_role: broad vertical bearing only; no numerical capacity credit before full-stack tests

integrated_cap_cassette_lock.per_bay_endpoint_policy: run-start terminal: both receivers tight; every internal support: previous/cornerward cassette receiver floating and next/outboard cassette receiver tight; run-end terminal: both receivers floating. Each of the nine fixed-crown bays therefore has exactly one tight wall datum and one 1.2 mm release endpoint, with expansion directed away from the inside corner
integrated_cap_cassette_lock.run_start_terminal_receiver_policy: both s = -18.9 and +18.9 mm receivers are tight 3.8 x 3.8 mm
integrated_cap_cassette_lock.internal_support_receiver_policy: previous/cornerward/negative-s cassette uses the 5.0 x 3.8 mm floating receiver; next/outboard/positive-s cassette uses the tight 3.8 x 3.8 mm receiver
integrated_cap_cassette_lock.run_end_terminal_receiver_policy: both s = -18.9 and +18.9 mm receivers are floating 5.0 x 3.8 mm
integrated_cap_cassette_lock.service_sweep_status: GEOMETRY_CLOSED: all 22 compressed-tail insertion/removal proxies clear the real cassette and corbel solids at every 0.4 mm station over the full 75 mm stroke; expanded-tail deformation remains actual-PETG coupon-gated
integrated_cap_cassette_lock.positive_keeper_rule: an integral split tail expands above the 3.2 mm cassette capture shoulder; the exposed underside pull head and release legs permit removal only after unload, and friction alone is prohibited
integrated_cap_cassette_lock.retention_credit: zero vertical-bearing, axial-restraint, or shelf-load capacity credit

corbel.floating_pier_ownership_rule: at every internal supported pier, the previous/cornerward/left cassette uses the 1.2 mm elongated locator pocket and lock slot while the next/outboard/right cassette is tight; the run-start terminal is tight and the run-end terminal floats, so each bay has exactly one wall-tight endpoint and expands away from the inside corner; the integral corbel cap carries vertical bearing only and receives zero axial-restraint credit
corbel.saved_orientation: wall-back xwall = 0 face on the build plate; installed elevation and run become the two bed axes and wall projection becomes build Z

print_connectivity_contract.common_build_face: xwall = 0 wall-back face shared by the wall plate, both X paths, and the integral bearing cap
print_connectivity_contract.bed_envelope_reason: the zero-credit pier-overlay parent plate extends the wall-back saved bed axis from structural e = 24..168 to e = 0..168; a 6 mm brim therefore consumes exactly 180 mm on that axis and requires a confirmed full usable 180 mm plate
print_connectivity_contract.build_height_reason: the wall-back-oriented structural corbel ends at 158.75 mm; the exact gravity-boss full head reaches 165.95 mm from its d=6.0 front face and now governs over the visible-front positive spring cross-key boss at 165.55 mm without changing the bed footprint
print_connectivity_contract.named_exception: the compact-clevis rear-cheek closures, locator-ridge onsets, cap-lock bore closures, and their local transitions require exact same-PETG support/sacrificial mapping plus actual-orientation coupons unless each is regenerated with a proven <=45 degree closure; AABB fit and connected layer sections alone are not printability proof

corbel.structural_credit: experimental only; no rating before destructive and sustained testing

joinery.design_language: Lincoln-Logs-style assembly using broad bearing shoulders, integrated corbel caps, positive quarter-turn mortise-and-tenon cross-keys, replaceable PETG pins, and floating cosmetic keys

run_seam_topology.rule: each of the 9 bays is fixed only at its crown seam; the 7 inter-bay seams centered over supported piers align adjacent bays but do not create one rigid 5 ft PETG chord

diaphragm_bowtie.floating_pier_seam_policy: at the 7 supported pier seams, one cassette pocket per bowtie is axially elongated by the qualified movement allowance and receives no longitudinal tension-splice credit

internal_upward_bayonet_track.owner: left crown cassette only, opposite the right crown-pin ear
internal_upward_bayonet_track.saved_orientation: keeper broad strip face on the build plate; widened tongue head cantilevers require an actual-orientation support/sacrificial coupon
internal_upward_bayonet_track.front_track_status: RETIRED_AS_A_TONGUE; the frozen front_* envelopes remain a compatibility keepout for the replacement pin chamber and may not emit a second tongue, flex hook, or catch
internal_upward_bayonet_track.rule: lift the widened rear keeper head 6.8 mm through its bottom entry, slide the strip 4.0 mm rearward into the narrowed 4.8 mm final shank throat, then install the separately printed indexed_vertical_quarter_turn_pin at u=9.2/q=95.45; the 11.2 mm head has exact 3.2 mm capture per run side, the pin blocks reverse slide, and every cassette receiver feature is subtractive or lies at e >= 138

positive_retention.positive_retention_release_status: SOURCE_CONTRACT_FROZEN_ONLY; RELEASE_MAPPING_BLOCKED_PENDING_GENERATOR_EMBODIMENT, REAL BOOLEAN SERVICE SWEEPS, CONFIRMED PRINTER/NOZZLE/PETG, AND ACTUAL-PARENT COUPONS
positive_retention.fixed_crown_integral_anti_reverse_rule: after the 4.0 mm rearward bayonet slide, one bottom-inserted indexed_vertical_quarter_turn_pin occupies the exact front-gap gate; its shaft blocks reverse slide, its rotated T-tail overlaps the gate, and its hard index nub seats in one orientation-specific pocket; friction alone is prohibited and the pin receives zero shelf-load credit
positive_retention.fixed_crown_guide_owner: left crown cassette only, opposite the right crown-pin ear; the right cassette has no keeper guide or catch, so the strip does not create a second structural seam splice
positive_retention.fixed_crown_coupon_gate: actual-orientation strip, rear guide, shared-pin gate/chamber/index, 100-cycle, thermal-cycle, 30-day screening migration, 90-day release migration, and bottom-removal coupons are required before installed use
positive_retention.fixed_crown_role: one underside strip covers all three fixed-crown bottom mouths after their keys are installed; its single rear bayonet tongue supplies vertical capture and the separate indexed quarter-turn pin supplies positive anti-reverse retention; both are zero-credit and bottom-removable after unload
positive_retention.floating_pier_trap_rule: the integrated corbel cap spans beneath all three pier-key mouths and uses a 10.8 mm tight left pocket plus a 12.0 mm elongated right pocket around the 10.4 mm ridge, physically trapping the keys while preserving the full 1.2 mm axial travel; no separate keeper object is installed at a pier seam
positive_retention.retention_credit: zero vertical, longitudinal-tension, or shelf-load capacity credit

fixed_crown_tie_key.installed_at: one per visible bay crown seam
fixed_crown_tie_key.role: directly splices the front cassette-entablature zone within each independently supported bay
fixed_crown_tie_key.insertion_axis: from the visible shelf front toward the rear along -q
fixed_crown_tie_key.positive_catch_rule: after the rear hard stop bears, the front-tie variant of indexed_vertical_quarter_turn_pin enters from the visible front along -q through the local integral tie eye at u=14/e=145.6, rotates -90 degrees inside the cassette-owned chamber, and seats its +e index nub; the locked tail cannot return through the 4.0 mm gate, friction is prohibited, and incidental arch contact is prohibited as retention
fixed_crown_tie_key.retention_credit: zero vertical or shelf-load capacity credit; broad receiver shoulders carry the candidate crown tie action
fixed_crown_tie_key.assembly_sequence: insert the front tie to its hard stop, insert and index its quarter-turn pin from the visible front along -q, then lift the arch halves; the flat 8 mm pull/index bar remains front-visible and serviceable after arch removal

floating_pier_seam_alignment_key.reason: the open-bottom receiver overlapped 18 final-X top-receiver paths across 14 cassettes; the three elongated diaphragm keys already provide transverse/vertical alignment and a fourth zero-credit key would add thermal constraint

shared_keeper_and_front_tie_quarter_turn.mechanism: one PETG pin family with two service-axis variants: the keeper pin enters vertically from below along +e and locks at +90 degrees, while the front-tie pin enters from the visible front along -q and locks at -90 degrees; each T-tail rotates inside an 8.8 mm square chamber, seats its single hard index nub, and cannot withdraw through its 4.0 mm throat while indexed
shared_keeper_and_front_tie_quarter_turn.printed_material: same qualified black PETG as both actual-parent receiver coupons
shared_keeper_and_front_tie_quarter_turn.installed_coordinate_system: u = run inward from the owned left crown-seam face, q = rear to visible front, e = upward; keeper service is +e from below and front-tie service is -q from the visible front

single_index_nub.owner: integral axial face of the positive locked long-axis end of the T-tail: +u for the vertical keeper variant and +e for the visible-front tie variant
single_index_nub.wrong_way_rule: only the positive locked long-axis position has a pocket (+u for the keeper and +e for the front tie); a wrong-way or 180 degree handle orientation cannot seat the nub and remains visibly proud by 0.6 mm

keeper_ordered_install_stages: approach from the open underside with the T-tail long axis parallel to q
translate straight upward by the receiver-specific insertion stroke until the tail is 0.8 mm above its indexed installed elevation
rotate exactly +90 degrees about +e at fixed translation while the full tail-and-nub sweep remains inside the 8.8 mm square chamber
translate 0.8 mm downward so the single 0.6 mm nub seats in the unique 0.8 mm locked pocket with 0.2 mm bottom clearance
keeper_ordered_removal_stages: fully unload the shelf and access the flat 8 mm pull/index bar from the open underside
push straight upward 0.8 mm so the index nub clears the chamber floor by 0.2 mm
rotate exactly -90 degrees about +e to return the T-tail long axis to q
withdraw straight downward by the receiver-specific insertion stroke until the tail has at least 0.4 mm clearance below the lowest crossed parent
front_tie_ordered_install_stages: approach from beyond q = 152.4 with the T-tail long axis parallel to u
translate straight toward the wall by 12.4 mm along -q until the tail is 0.8 mm beyond its indexed installed elevation
rotate exactly -90 degrees about +q at fixed translation so the T-tail long axis becomes e while the full tail-and-nub sweep remains inside the 8.8 mm square chamber
translate 0.8 mm toward the visible front so the positive-e nub seats in its unique pocket with 0.2 mm bottom clearance
front_tie_ordered_removal_stages: fully unload the shelf, remove the crown bridge and arch halves, and access the flat 8 mm pull/index bar from the visible front
push 0.8 mm toward the wall along -q so the index nub clears its pocket by 0.2 mm
rotate exactly +90 degrees about +q to return the T-tail long axis to u
withdraw toward the visible front along +q until the tail is at least 0.4 mm beyond q = 152.4

fixed_crown_interface_assembly_sequence: install three diaphragm keys from the open underside
lift the keeper rear tongue and slide the strip 4.0 mm rearward
insert, quarter-turn, and positively index the keeper-reach pin from the open underside
insert the fixed front tie to its rear hard stop
insert, quarter-turn, and positively index the front-tie-reach pin from the visible front along -q
lift both arch halves at their final run coordinates
lift and pin the crown bridge
shared_keeper_and_front_tie_quarter_turn.fixed_crown_interface_disassembly_rule: fully unload; remove the crown bridge and lower both arch halves, then push/quarter-turn/withdraw the front-tie pin and pull the tie, push/quarter-turn/withdraw the keeper pin, slide the keeper 4.0 mm forward and lower its rear tongue, and finally lower the three diaphragm keys; no wall/rear/top access is permitted

keeper_reach_variant.owner: left fixed-crown cassette only; opposite the right crown-bridge pin ear
keeper_reach_variant.retention_action: the retained rear tongue captures vertical fall; the pin shaft blocks the 4.0 mm forward unlock slide and the indexed T-tail blocks pin withdrawal

front_tie_reach_variant.owner: left fixed-crown cassette and the installed fixed-crown tie only
front_tie_reach_variant.local_eye_parent_ownership_rule: restore the cassette-owned receiver boss before cutting its chamber/throat/eye-fit cavity; trim only the generic tie material behind q = 143.6 inside the local eye footprint; the front eye remains positively unioned to the untrimmed tie body and the broad hard stop remains elsewhere
front_tie_reach_variant.retention_action: the tie hard stop carries seating contact; the cassette-owned throat captures the rotated tail, the shaft blocks visible-front tie withdrawal, and the +e index nub blocks self-rotation

saved_print_orientation.orientation: shaft axis parallel to the build plate with the flat 8 x 3.2 mm pull/index bar broad face and one T-tail edge on the plate; an upright shaft is not an allowed software-model source orientation

required_pass_conditions: no tail escape, false index seating, self-rotation, crack, whitening, layer split, or permanent interference
the index nub remains visibly seated only at +90 degrees and remains at least 0.4 mm engaged after cycling and both migration dwells
the keeper variant remains removable solely from the open underside and the front-tie variant solely from the visible front, using their exact push/quarter-turn/withdraw sequences
the keeper strip still slides the full 4.0 mm only after its pin is removed and never gains structural splice credit
fit is recorded for the exact printer, nozzle, layer height, PETG brand/color/dry state, saved orientation, and clearance rung
qualification_gate.failure_rule: any missed hard index, gate escape, wall/rear/top access need, parent damage, creep migration, or nonserviceable pin fails both family variants and blocks all complete-shelf packages

object_count_impact_contract.inventory_update_status: LOGICAL_INVENTORY_AND_PACKAGE_PLANS_INTEGRATED; software-model mapping completes only when the runtime generator proves both actual-parent receiver variants and exact solid service sweeps; physical installation and production remain unqualified

shared_keeper_and_front_tie_quarter_turn.retention_credit: zero vertical, bearing, shear, longitudinal-tension, or shelf-load capacity credit; no numerical load rating
shared_keeper_and_front_tie_quarter_turn.software_model_mapping_completion_gate: the runtime generator must embody both pins, both actual-parent gates/chambers/roofs/pockets, the keeper rear-tongue-only state, and exact solid insertion/rotation/removal booleans before it may report software_model_mapping_complete true

joinery.primary_joint_rule: normal shelf load crosses broad compression/bearing faces; cross-keys and pins retain the joint and are not intentionally used as tiny cantilever load paths
joinery.wrong_way_prevention: asymmetric locator lands and handed crown keys prevent reversed assembly
joinery.thermal_movement_policy: structural arms are independently supported; nine crown seams are fixed locally within their bays, seven pier seams use 1.2 mm elongated integrated-cap locator/key/lock seats, cosmetic keys float, and no adhesive, optional study rail, or ornament may create one rigid 5 ft PETG chord
joinery.field_disassembly_order: fully unload and remove stored items and isolated ornament; squeeze/pull the crown-bridge pin and lower the bridge; release, quarter-turn and withdraw two cassette cross-keys plus one spring cross-key from each half; lower each half vertically at its final run coordinate; remove front-tie and keeper indexed pins, ties, keeper strips, cap locks and seam keys; separate the cassette train; finally unscrew the integral-cap pier/X-corbels

palatine.arch_geometry_and_seam_source: use tied_arcade visual_facade_* fields only; structural arch fields are prohibited in removable ornament geometry

visual_carrier_contract.seam_rule: every physical carrier is authored Wp=Wn-0.6 and installed with a +0.3 mm local-origin offset, leaving exact 0.6 mm global AABB gaps at every crown and shared-pier boundary; no keystone, ray, chevron, dentil, overlay, or carrier solid crosses a seam

cross_key_oculus_access_contract.saved_orientation_rule: the oculus cutter and its stepped visible border are authored in the released decorated-face-down carrier orientation; the complete d=0..10.2 chase remains open after reorientation
cross_key_oculus_access_contract.actual_parent_coupon_gate: qualify all four exact haunch-web carrier maps plus the interior, run-start, and run-end pier plates with their real two-boss/one-locator topology as actual-parent orientation coupons; a generic face coupon cannot authorize mapping
cross_key_oculus_access_contract.mapping_qualification_rule: the generator must embody all 58 full-depth swept oculi, all 88 gravity bosses, all 11 loose locators and their actual-parent coupons before it may report software_model_mapping_complete; physical fit/cycle/migration qualification remains false and production release remains ineligible

ornament_keyhole_contract.mapping_qualification_rule: the eight exact attachment maps and five exact cross-key access maps are frozen source contracts; only generator execution may report software_model_mapping_complete after every integral parent plate/panel/boss/locator, full-depth swept oculus, and strict installed/swept-solid check passes; actual-parent coupons and all physical gates remain unpassed
ornament_keyhole_contract.parent_saved_orientation: use the exact per-family parent orientation; a separately reoriented boss ladder is never representative

ornament_isolation.rule: fine archivolts, flutes, dentils, paterae, rosettes, cavetto moldings, seam keys, overlays, and visible keystones attach only to the 99 isolated integral parent bosses per level and may be removed without reducing chassis stability
